description: Inspect a live website URL for Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI assistant citation readiness: verifies whether `/robots.txt` allows 8 major AI search crawlers (OAI-SearchBot, GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended, CCBot), validates `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt` Markdown indexes, and extracts Schema.org `application/ld+json` entities. Use this tool for AI SEO and `/llms.txt` checks on a single URL; use `full_launch_readiness_audit` when running a complete pre-launch sweep.

url.description: Public website URL or domain to inspect (e.g. 'https://cal.com' or 'linear.app').

aiCrawlers.description: Allowed and blocked AI crawler summary.

grade.description: Letter grade from A to D.

structuredData.description: Detected Schema.org JSON-LD types and metadata tags.
